attchmntText: Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: McNally Bharat Engineering Company Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the results on 12th November 2026. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 3,466.06 lakhs. The company reported a loss after tax of 4,068.94 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at negative 12.21. Total assets were 81,603.09 lakhs. The Board also approved a Postal Ballot Notice seeking shareholder approval for the appointment of Mr. Pradumn Kumar Dixit as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. The notice will be dispatched to members on the cut-off date of 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Mcnally Bharat Engineering Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Pradumn Dixit as Non- Executive Non - Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 02, 2026.
